item.title: Dose of Jagjeevan – Conflict is Natural. So Should Be Its Resolution
item.description: In continuation of the Jagjeevan Doses, I want to share a lesson that became even more meaningful after a recent conversation. Ironically, I was asked a simple leadership question that I couldn’t answer as well as I wanted. “Suppose you strongly believe you have the right solution. You have supporting data, clear reasoning, and good intentions. Yet a critical stakeholder still insists on taking a different path that they like. What would you do?
